hh_ethnologue_comment.comment: E17/E18/E19/E20/E21/E22/E23/E24/E25/E26/E27/E28/E29 has a separate entry for Batyala [xby], but this language was close enough linguistically to count as a variety of Kabikabi [gbw] (**hh:hvw:Breen:Western-Queensland:1971**, **hh:sd:Bell:Badjala**, **hh:hvwphon:Holmer:South-Eastern-Queensland**). See also: Kabikabi [gbw].
